data: Great game, amazing story, awesome to 100% :)
This game is so beautiful, the story is amazing and the gameplay is really solid and relaxing
Fantastic game can't wait to play the dlc
A beautiful love letter to the zelda games, 10/10
10/10 Great music, Great Art, Great Game
I loved A Short Hike and this game makes that game look like the early alpha version of this game. Relaxing, nostalgic, beautiful, and fun, what more could you want in a game.

DISCLAIMER: This is a full review, and NOT a first impressions review

Lil Gator Game is a game developed by MegaWobble and published by Playtonic Friends

The game offers some pleasant graphics and really vibrant colours, although some ugly glitches here and there, it is pleasant all the same

The game does suffer with some repetitiveness at certain areas of the game but a fun game nontheless

Lil Gator Game overall, however, is a fun game to play, has a really cute and funny story, characters and concept and a great, yet sometimes repetitive, casual game to play!

RECOMMENDED :)

REVIEW SOURCES:

None

I fully 100% this game recently and had a great time! It is so cute and just a genuinely fun experience. The movement is intuitive and fun and allows for some creative exploration like using different combinations of items. The dialogue is adorable and funny and the story almost made me cry. I definitely recommend this game to people who like shorter, cute games. I would compare this game most to A Short Hike, a game I also loved. The gator is adorable and I love him, 10/10.

One of my favourite games I've played in recent years, lighthearted and fun the whole way to getting a 100% in the base game. Short and sweet, the simple story was touching and helped me feel better during a time when I wasn't feeling so great. I'm really excited to play the dlc when i can get it sometime!
Cute and fun to 100%, the story was pretty cute too you can tell it comes from a place of love

Lil Gator Game reminds me a lot of the show Bluey.

It has this focus on a cast of primarily children who are wrapped up in their various forms of play, using their games to enjoy their time while also using those same games to process their feelings and thoughts about the world around them and what's happening to them.

Without spoiling anything, I will say this is a very cozy and enjoyable open world game like Breath of the Wild or Genshin Impact but much smaller scale and through the imaginative lens of a child that will leave you feeling good by the end. I'd definitely say it's worth playing.
A delightul window back into being a kid when all you had to do was run around, explore and make friends. I really recommend this, its fun.

If you like wholesome games that are chill and adorable then this is the game for you!
I have currently played through the story but I am still working on completion.
The ending made me tear up and the references made me laugh.
Once I opened the game I never wanted to stop playing! I beat the story in two long sessions.

The game runs very well on a laptop that isn't very powerful! I played on basically low everything and the game looked beautiful still!

This is one of my fave games released this year.

10/10 game.
Fun, beautiful, and meaningful game. Designed well and fun and engaging, I want my kids to play this.
Short, sweet and simple. A really good short game that reminded me of my own adventures as a kid even though I'm more like the big sis these days.

This game is incredibly fun! the charm, the animations, the dialog, its all so appealing. I had this on my wishlist for a couple of months waiting on a sale, bought at 13.00 is a steal. even at full price I would recommend.

This game is peak when it comes to coziness. Really chill and fun gameplay with great characters and story. 

Highly recommended for people who like cozy games with no stress!
Takes idea of 'a short hike' and improves on it by adding free camera, more personal story, and more content overall

The game is rather short, but it's fun, it's a love letter to Legend of Zelda and other similar games, very cute, very fun for both adults and children, bitter sweet ending, very good game, would recommend!
Adorable and fun game that was a lot longer than I was expecting. Really enjoyed completing this one, and the game gives you good tools to make sure you can 100% it easily. Highly recommend.

Very cute story about growing up, clearly inspired by a short hike but is an upgrade in most ways. There is still no map but having full camera control makes it a lot easier to keep your bearings. It could have used a quest tracker for sure though. I spent a long time just wandering and finding friends before looking it up online to figure out the main goal.

The only weird thing about it is trying to understand everyone's ages. If they are supposed to equate to humans, big sis is in college, but lil gator looks and acts like a toddler even though his friends talk about getting ready for college, implying that they are all maybe 16 to 18? If they are going for a "kids of all ages" thing that's fine and if you don't think too hard about it then it doesn't really matter.

I will be playing the DLC for sure
This game goes hard, surprisingly great movement that you wouldn't expect in a game like this.

This game has so much charm and personality! Very colorful and fun graphics along with unique characters, stories between them, and themes. A really interesting and fun take on a hero's journey, and the messages from the base game and dlc are awesome. I love this game and it is securely one of my favorite games of all time! :D

Cutest game I've ever played.

9/10

So glad I came back to Lil Gator Game after a few months break and actually finished it.
I even cried a bit. Lovely way to do storytelling.

Lil' gator game is one of the cutest games I've played in a while. It is, by its design, very childish, but that is the charm of this game. I was very much reminded of when I was little. Its 'quests' are short but engaging and its mechanics are well-thought. I'd very much recommend this game!

its such a fun time going around and getting power up bracelets xD and a vast choice of weapons / accessory's with different mechanics to them. the ending was such a tearjerker and i have enjoyed all the questing even the go over there and its done ones 10/10

Been exploring this game and so far everything I've found including the characters, places and even the music have been amazing and chill. If I had any minor thing, it would be there is a lot of dialog to read through, but this isn't in any way a problem.

This was NEEDLESSLY wholesome and I love it. Such an adorable game with fun exploration, a good art style, and these precious moments. It really did a great job putting you through the lens of a kid just having fun, making friends, and wanting to spend time with his sister. SO adorable and whole. Just a blast and definitely worth the price.

Fun, wholesome, whimsical and childish in the best possible way.

This game got more than a couple genuine smiles and laughs out of a grown-ass man after a rough week.

I got this game through Humble Bundle choice, but even at full price there are a LOT of worse ways to spend your money.
A Zelda BOTW adventure game with such a cute story, can get slow at times, but easy to pick up and play with so many cute characters with funny lines. Worth it for a chill game.

I don't want to grow up, but we kinda have to focus on what's important.
I personally connected with lil gator guy, because i felt the exact same in the summer between my last highschool semester and the proccess of going to college, i didn't want to grow up, but i have to.
10/10, would gator again, tears of the kingdom ain't got nothing on this

Really enjoyed this! The story is sweet, the puzzles are fun, and the post-credit level ups make completing the achievements really enjoyable as well. Worth the price. Beautiful music, fun but not overly complicated quests. Beautiful animations. Really fun to explore the island on its own, let alone conquering all of the cardboard monsters and completing the storyline.
SO CUTE, i love this game. i highly recommend if you're looking for something casual but not something that feels shallow or pointless.

It's just a lovely stress free time, with characters and dialogue that consistently makes me smile all the way through, and surprisingly with varied and dense enough movement options that make me seriously consider trying a speedrun of the game on my second, third... eighth playthrough of the game. And I never speedrun anything. The movement and physics are just that fun to muck about with.

I love this game, I've got it on several platforms, this game feels like a warm hug from your childhood and plays like it too. A must play for indie game fans.

DLC Update: The DLC adds a lot of new content to the game and it is a charming and perfect addition to the game! Keep up the great work guys!
Super mag wholesome kind peaceful happy game to play to just relax, makes you want to see your friends and family ^^
A short, sweet adventure that let's you experience what it's like to be a kid again. A truly amazing experience that I recommend to anyone.

It is sunday in the middle of summer. Too hot to do anything else. I look through my steam library wondering what to do for the day. And there is 'Lil Gator Game' which I bought on a whim a while ago.

And it might not be the game I was searching for and thought I wanted to play but it surely was the game I needed to play this exact day. Basically playing through in one sitting I enjoyed this little adventure telling about friendship, growing up and staying young at heart. I can only whole heartedly recommend playing this very tight, heart-warming game.

This game without a doubt is some of the best fun I've had in a while. Wonderful experience with a cast of colourful characters. The story and the overall message of the game really resonated with me and tugged my heart. 10/10 very cute I cried.
I skipped dialogue so I have no Idea what to do, but it is still fun.
It's a cute game. Well written. Controls are good. I got 100% in around 6 hours and will be playing through the game again sometime in the future.
Best Game ever! Cute and charismatic animal, they gives nice and simple quest. Cozy game filled with fun.
Loved the writing and all the little easter eggs in this one. :) Looking forward to the DLC!
Very short and cute adventure game. 8/10 it was really neat and wholesome, I wish it was a little longer tho.
It is a very cute game a real labor of love. It is very short though so maybe pick it up on a sale? It has the same vibes as "A short hike" and both games are phenomenal.

If you have siblings I'd highly recommend this game. It's quite touching and heartfelt for such a short experience. The atmosphere, gameplay, music, and story all combine into a fun package that I'm happy I got to experience. Remember to make time for people you care about.
This game is one of the cutest games I've ever played, I fell in love with it from the outset and loved it even more at the story's end, incredible game

This game is too damn adorable, really reminds you of the feeling when you and your friends played as kids. 

Everything about this game is wholesome.

Very cozy game, perfect for a weekend afternoon. Exploration-wse, the game took the best parts of the BotW Zeldas, but there's also silly humor and even some heartfelt moments. Beat the whole game in one sitting, highly recommend if you want to wind down and/or if you enjoyed The Short Hike.

Easily among the most adorable games I've played. It's the kind of story where if you haven't been in this spot before, you can relate, and it helps that everything's so cute. The graphics are cute. The characters are cute. Even the "enemies" are cute.

What helps is that the gameplay is really tight and forgiving, too. You can get around with ease after just a few minutes, and there's no real stakes stopping you from failing. The only thing is that anyone wanting to buy this game should keep the short length in mind--I saw the ending at just under 4 hours, and I've seen estimates that you can 100% this game in 5 hours. At the same time, it's worth it; it's a well crafted and tightly made game for those five hours.

In a world of embarrassing shovelware thrown at kids, here is a RARE masterpiece. I remember as a kid top quality games aimed at my age range were few and far between. I also remember being burned countless times by garbage which were released on expensive cartridges. AVGN made an entire living off reviewing such games. Here is an example of developers who truly respect the consumer and have a passion for game development. Though there is no way to "lose" the gameplay is polished and fun. The writing is witty and for all ages. I experienced ZERO audio, graphical, or gameplay glitches. I can't recommend this one enough.

Finally a fun cute game without some weird existential crisis in the background!

Gator/10 - Would advise everyone play it!

It's a fun game. Has many adorable moments and flailing. Took 4.5 hours for 100% completion. Was worth every penny. Has no form of combat but excels in exploration. Would highly recommend. Nothing like going on an ADVENTURE!!!

This game is like being wrapped in a warm blanket, with a nice cup of hot coco. The theme is perfect, the gameplay is so much fun, and to top it off you play as a little gator which I think they dont get enough love as it is in life.

After I finished the base game I was gifted by a friend for the first time, the DLC released just a few days afterwards. I had enjoyed my time with the base game so much, I immediately bought the DLC- something I don't do often, and have not once regretted it.

I can say for sure the DLC built upon the story of the original, and adds plenty of growth for the characters you come to care about. Both the base and DLC had me laughing every now and then at how fun the writing is.

The base game (and by extension the DLC) never overstayed its welcome or felt too short. All of the mechanics were really fun. It was surprisingly fun to whack everything over and over again despite the cut outs never moving. It only got a little boring when I wanted to 100% it, but even then it wasn't a huge drag since I only had to sit down for like 15-30 minutes to do so, giving me a satisfying feeling without any frustrations.

It is an absolutely adorable and charming game which I recommend wholeheartedly to anyone who wants to play something wholesome, non-challenging, and entertaining.

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (99%): many reviews praise the story and characters.
Complaints are few and spread across different topics, so no single issue stands out.

details.text: Reviews from the last 30 days are about as positive as the all-time score, so recent players agree with the overall picture.
New players are less positive, at 90%, than players who have logged many hours, who are almost all positive.
